sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:130

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:130:1
items.html:
At first the four Mochin themselves were discernible, hence it is called the Mem of Tzelem; but here their existence is concealed, etc., and the discernment of the Mochin is concealed and covered within this Lamed: For here they become only three Mochin, called Hochma, Bina, Daat; but in the discernment of the Mem of Tzelem, which is the discernment of the upper AVI, they are not called so, but rather: Hochma, Bina, Hesed, and Gevura. For this coupling of Hesed and Gevura in the secret of the Daat, which strikes upon Hochma and Bina and brings out from them their illuminations to be revealed outwardly, has there as yet no revelation whatsoever, but rather they couple there in the discernment of the concealed Daat, as said in its place, and therefore the coupling of Hesed and Gevura has not yet been completed there to its end, until both of them become one brain; and they are therefore regarded there as two Mochin, Hesed and Gevura. And therefore there are four Mochin there. And you already know the reason for this, which is because they are in the secret of covered Hassadim, in the secret of “for He desires mercy,” and the Daat cannot be revealed there and bring out the illumination of Hochma outward.
But in the NHY of the third Tevuna, which is the discernment of YESHSUT within it, where the Hassadim can be revealed, as above, this coupling of Hesed and Gevura is made there, which raise reflected light up to Hochma and Bina, and bring out the illumination of Hochma outward, and this coupling unites Hesed and Gevura into one brain, by the name the brain of Daat. And there is much understanding here. For the very existence of the Mochin is from the upper AVI, that is, from the Mem of Tzelem, and behold, in them there is no place for the revelation of the illumination of Hochma, but they are the discernment of Hassadim without the illumination of Hochma, as above. And when they descend in the second expansion to the Lamed of Tzelem, the intense dominion that was in them from their source in the Mem, to cover the Hochma, is concealed, and they receive the discernment of the dominion of the new garments, which are YESHSUT, and the HG become united, and reveal the illumination of Hochma as is the nature of YESHSUT.
And this is what he says, “but here their existence is concealed, and only the garments are discernible, which are the NHY of Tevuna, and are called the Lamed of Tzelem, and the discernment of the Mochin is concealed and covered within this Lamed”: meaning, as explained, that although the nature of these Mochin, from their source, is an ingrained desire to cover the Hochma, in the secret of “for He desires mercy,” yet when they come to the place of the NHY of the third Tevuna, which is the discernment of YESHSUT, and clothe in them, the power of covering that is in the Mochin becomes concealed in the garments, which are YESHSUT, and the garments overpower them and bring out and reveal the illumination of Hochma in the Hassadim. As above.
